description: Foreign-exchange reference rates for a base currency and up to 12 target currencies, with the reference date and the source that answered. Primary path is the ECB-based frankfurter.dev feed; if it is unavailable the call falls back to a second provider and says so in the report rather than hiding the substitution. Currencies the source does not publish are listed in gaps. Use it to convert amounts, sanity-check an invoice, or settle a cross-currency budget. Paid per call via x402 (USDC on Base, no account, no API key). 【価格】0.00 USDC。【使い方】呼ぶと 402 と PAYMENT-REQUIRED（支払い条件）が返る。USDC で支払い、同じ引数に PAYMENT-SIGNATURE ヘッダを添えて再送すると結果が返る。

symbols.description: Target currency codes (default JPY, EUR, GBP)
